entries.092004b24d8079a0: This is a single-segment business conducted by a group consisting of the company, 7 subsidiaries, 1 associate and 1 other affiliated company. entries.32d1101729a9f049: Aiming for its 100th anniversary in the fiscal year ending March 2033, it has set a long-term vision, 'Growth Navigator (a group that navigates growth and builds it together)', and is working on the medium-term management plan 'Trust & Challenge 2029' covering the fiscal years ending March 2027 through March 2029. The plan aims to transform the company into a professional services company, built around a shift to a value-creation model premised on AI (transition to AI Native), an evolution toward a service-centred revenue model anchored in engineering services, inorganic growth through strategic investment, and a transformation of its talent portfolio. During the year, the company concluded an AI partnership with IBM Japan, Ltd. and strengthened the functions of its cloud-based fleet and delivery management service 'TCloud for SCM'.
